scope: New standalone executor only; protected r17/candidate2 source and original guards untouched. Parent stages/reviews/executes through existing root SSH wrapper.
prepare_command: python3 -B <private-executor>/serial_trial.py prepare --journal <private0700-trial-dir>/state.json --candidate-dir <private0700-candidate-dir> --manifest-sha256 b697628ac2588881628e809e207a8bbc5e88f9d0ab40a433749e1d875aa38ccd --readback /home/root/aura-board-owner-candidate-20261030/private-pin-8100a7fd-20261030/face_gallery_readback.local.json --readback-sha256 <exact current private file SHA> --expected-boot 8100a7fd-0c6a-46c4-82b8-f874988a1521 --expected-pid <reobserved current PID> --expected-birth <reobserved proc stat ticks>

additional_actions.status: Whitelisted durable journal summary only; it is not a fresh hardware readiness claim.
additional_actions.stop-candidate: Also allowed during a partial STARTING_CANDIDATE, with exact observed new owner and safe normal close.
additional_actions.stop-restored: Also allowed during partial RESTORING; only a newly written exact final checkpoint permits explicit restoration again.

next_action_gates: Prepare must return GUARDED, exact baseline PID/birth/cmdline/readback/source/model/unit pins verified; it creates only its uniquely named runtime guard drop-in. It never stops or starts an owner.
STOPPING and STARTING PENDING do not authorize the next phase. Repeating the same action observes the recorded intent and never blindly resends a start.
stop-baseline/candidate/restored requires effective Restart=no, SendSIGKILL=no, TimeoutStopUSec=infinity, KillSignal=SIGTERM, no ExecStop/ExecStopPost helper and unchanged unit/source hashes.
Only a confirmed-dead exact predecessor plus a fresh sealed current-boot private checkpoint with unchanged native unit/source/history and original load_business_checkpoint validation permits a start.

New owner validation requires exact argv/PID/birth/approved mapped library, generated runtime differing ONLY in inherited seed SHA, exclusive consumed marker, original counters/SFace floors, unchanged history, fresh face/person health and stable epoch/frame progress.
finalize rechecks the restored original owner and health before deleting only this script own drop-in, then restores original effective unit settings and rechecks owner again.
safety_and_recovery: Private root-owned atomic fsync journal, per-journal nonblocking writer lock, global per-unit action lock, and refusal of another active trial drop-in.
No kill command, SIGKILL, native reset, marker removal, checkpoint byte overwrite/reseed or parallel service exists.
A start-client interruption is treated as ambiguous. If no owner appears, the executor holds STARTING and does not auto-retry; parent must audit rather than replay a consumed SHA.
UNSAFE_OWNER_RETAINED or unconfirmed native close keeps the sole owner and guards in place. No automatic rollback or replacement.
An interrupted own drop-in write/reload/finalization can resume only its exact journaled bytes. Other drop-in or unit changes refuse further actions.
Full source/model hashes run at action boundaries and before success, rather than on every health poll; fixed loopback metadata HTTP has an absolute 750 ms deadline.
A restored entry uses the candidate NEW checkpoint; the original oldboot checkpoint and previous consumed markers are never replayed or removed.
After any new owner, old private face readback remains stale and unchanged; explicit fresh PID-bound readback remains a separate root action.
not_implemented_here: Performance acceptance and automatic candidate selection
fixture_limit: 66 combined cases are simulated OS/systemd/native metadata plus inherited candidate tests. Actual Linux properties/file ownership/health shapes and native handoff still require parent review and serial execution. Nonempty original ExecStop/ExecStopPost, a noncanonical unit path, different original command or missing SFace health counters deliberately refuse.
